title: The Bell levitated and had to be chained down

tellings.quote: But the reason that rig exists >> is because they realized that this thing levitates when you turn it on >> and they had to chain it down.

plain: The Bell, a device said to have been built for a secret Nazi German program in the 1940s, is claimed to have lifted off the ground when switched on, so its makers had to chain it down. The researcher Jason Jorjani says this without naming a source. He says the test rig around the device exists "because they realized that this thing levitates when you turn it on," which, if true, would mean the Germans had a working anti-gravity machine.
